confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sicilian pricing in peak summer; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July rates vary widely by season, availability and booking window. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer-to-drink price relationship, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result text attributed to RBA pages (0.6955 USD per AUD as at 4.00 pm on 2026-10-15); the RBA page itself was not opened, and the 2026-10-16 figure reported by a third party was not used because it is not an RBA publication.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized southern Italian and Sicilian tourist cities such as Palermo and Syracuse, with Catania's typical trattoria, café and guesthouse price levels.
